name: Apple 60W USB-C Charge Cable (1 m)
shortDescription: Apple's 1-metre woven USB-C to USB-C cable for charging at up to 60W and syncing at USB 2 speeds.
description:
A 1-metre woven cable with USB-C connectors on both ends. It charges at up to 60W and transfers data at USB 2 speeds, so it suits iPhone 15 and later, iPad and Mac models with USB-C.

Pair it with a USB-C power adapter (sold separately) for fast charging.
warranty: 1 year Apple limited warranty for accessories, from the date of purchase, in addition to your rights under consumer law.
